NSM_Policy.what: Turn features of a device kind on or off, or set their parameters.
NSM_Policy.ifAbsent: Every device of the kind runs all its features that are on by default.

Kind.description: Device kind to tweak (one record per kind); the kinds with features to tweak are listed under 'kinds' below.

Policy.description: One entry per group of devices: Devices (names; empty means all devices of the kind), then {"<Feature>": {"Enabled": false}} to switch a feature off or {"<Feature>": {"<Parameter>": value}} to set a parameter, and TemplateValues for the names under the kind's templateValues. A kind file lists its features as "Feature": ["Parameter:type", ...]; all are on by default except those under offByDefault.

ChassisBridgingAssociation.does: Links this chassis to the SMA chassis that bridges it (bridged and bridging chassis), so Redfish shows which management device reaches it. Does nothing when no bridge name is set.

ChassisPCIeDeviceAERErrorStatus.does: Publishes PCIe Advanced Error Reporting status for a retimer or NIC PCIe device, visible under the chassis PCIeDevice in Redfish.

ChassisPCIeDeviceAsset.does: Publishes manufacturer, part number, serial number and model for the chassis PCIeDevice, read from the device.

ChassisPCIeDeviceAssociations.does: Links the chassis PCIeDevice to its owning chassis so Redfish lists it under that chassis. Controlled by SelfChassisAssociationsEnabled.

ChassisPCIeDeviceHealth.does: Adds a Health status (OK) to the chassis PCIeDevice so Redfish shows its health.

ChassisPCIeDeviceMultiPortPCIeDevice.does: Publishes a multi-port PCIe device (NIC or retimer) with link speed, functions and bus numbers, visible as a Redfish PCIeDevice.

ChassisPCIeDeviceUUID.does: Publishes the PCIeDevice's UUID, read from the device over MCTP, for Redfish and for matching devices.

DebugToken.does: Enables debug-token handling for the device: install and status for a unified token, or a token object for NICs. Only built when the debug-token compile option is on.

FWComponentType.does: Placeholder: records the firmware component type but creates nothing; no nsmd consumer exists (code says open question).

IRoTAsset.does: Publishes the IRoT's asset data (manufacturer, part and serial number, optional display name) on its chassis.

IRoTAssociations.does: Builds the IRoT's links: parent chassis, the components it protects (RoT inventory) and its chassis. Which links exist is set by the Enabled flags and path params.

IRoTChassisType.does: Sets the IRoT chassis type (for example Component) shown in Redfish. Skipped if no ChassisType param is given.

IRoTFieldReplaceable.does: Marks the IRoT as field replaceable or not in inventory. Skipped if the param is absent.

IRoTHealth.does: Adds a Health status to the IRoT chassis in Redfish.

IRoTLocationCode.does: Sets the IRoT's location code (for example IRoT_0) in inventory. Skipped if no LocationCode param.

IRoTLocationContext.does: Sets the IRoT's location context path (where it sits in the chassis hierarchy) in inventory. Skipped if absent.

IRoTLocationType.does: Sets the IRoT's location type (for example Embedded) in inventory. Skipped if absent.

IRoTSPDMResponder.does: Publishes the IRoT's UUID (and optionally MCTP UUID) so the SPDM service can find and attest it. MctpUuidEnabled adds the MCTP UUID; HGXR disables it.

MultiPCIeLink.does: Discovers and publishes the PCIe ports (upstream and downstream) of a retimer switch under its fabric in Redfish.

MultiPortPCIeSwitchDevice.does: Publishes the PCIe retimer as a switch on the PCIe fabric in Redfish, linked to its chassis and fabric, with periodic refresh.

NVLinkMgmtNicChassis.does: Creates the chassis identity (UUID) for an NVLink management NIC, and device-reset objects when reset is supported.

NVLinkMgmtNicChassisAssembly.does: Adds a chassis Assembly entry for a NVLink management NIC, numbered with the device's other assemblies.

NVLinkMgmtNicChassisAttributes.does: Fills in the NVLink management NIC chassis properties: asset data, location, chassis type, field-replaceable, health.

NetworkAdapter.does: Publishes the NIC as a Redfish network adapter with PCIe device info, plus mode controls (DPU, PCIe mode, protection options) per DeviceModesSupported. Debug, wipe and reset objects depend on build options.

PCIeRetimerFabrics.does: Publishes the PCIe fabric object (for example PCIeTopology_<device>) in Redfish that retimer switches and ports sit under.

Port.does: Creates the network ports of a NIC (count from params) with port metrics, MAC and GUID addresses, optional optical module telemetry, reset and FEC histograms.

RoT.does: Creates the Root of Trust firmware model: slots (active and inactive AP and EC), key management, minimum security version, build type, optional image copy, update and failover policies. Slot arrays in params define it.

Chassis.does: Creates the device's chassis identity: its UUID and MCTP UUID, used by Redfish and by other services to match the device. Needed for every device that has a chassis.

DRAM_0_Power_0.does: Publishes the GPU memory (DRAM) power sensor, associated with the GPU, its chassis and its memory in Redfish.

EventConfigDeviceCapabilityDiscovery.does: Subscribes the GPU to its device-capability-discovery events (message type 0, events 1 and 2) so rediscovery notifications reach nsmd.

EventConfigDiagnostics.does: Subscribes the GPU to diagnostic events (message type 4, event 4), needed for runtime in-system-test completion events.

EventConfigNetworkPort.does: Subscribes the GPU to network-port events (message type 1, event 0), the source of threshold events.

EventConfigPlatformEnvironment.does: Subscribes the GPU to platform-environment events (message type 3, events 0 to 2), the source of XID and reset-required events.

EventSetting.does: Sets how the device generates events (global event generation setting, for example push) and reads it back. Needed for any event feature to work.

GPMPortMetrics.does: Publishes per-NVLink-port bandwidth metrics (raw and data, Tx and Rx) from GPU performance monitoring. Metrics and NVLinkCount params choose what is shown.

GPUSWInventory.does: Publishes the GPU driver software version and status in the Redfish firmware inventory, linked to the GPU.

MemoryLocation.does: Sets the GPU memory's location code and location context in inventory. Skipped when both are empty.

NVLink.does: Creates the device's NVLink ports (count from params) with per-port metrics, link health, optional FEC histograms, topology links and location. One port object per Count.

PCIe_0.does: Publishes the GPU's PCIe port with link speed, width, lane errors, ECC counters and clear-counter actions, linked to the GPU.

PCIe_0_PortInfo.does: Adds port type and protocol info and link information for the GPU's PCIe port.

PowerCap.does: Publishes the GPU power cap (limit and range) with settable controls.

Power_0.does: Publishes the GPU's total power sensor, with peak-value tracking and a link to the total GPU power sensor in Redfish.

Processor.does: Publishes the GPU as a Redfish processor: health, UUID, revision, memory size, reset counters, confidential-compute mode and links to its chassis. The main GPU inventory object.

ProcessorAttributes.does: Adds GPU asset data, location and optional GPU controls (MIG, ECC, power smoothing, power limits, EGM, NVLink count, CPER events), each enabled by a Supported flag. Switch off flags the platform's GPU lacks.

ProcessorPerformance.does: Publishes GPU performance state and throttle reasons for the processor.

ReconfigPermissions.does: Publishes which GPU configuration knobs (for example CC mode, ECC, clock limit) may be reconfigured. AvailableKnobs minus DisabledKnobs sets the list; a platform can disable knobs there.

RediscoveryEvent.does: Turns the GPU's rediscovery event into a log entry and Redfish event, and triggers re-reading capabilities. Message, severity and namespace come from params.

ResetRequiredEvent.does: Turns the GPU's reset-required event into a Warning log entry and Redfish event telling the user to reset or power cycle.

RoT.does: Creates the Root of Trust firmware model: slots (active and inactive AP and EC), key management, minimum security version, build type, optional image copy, update and failover policies. Slot arrays in params define it.

RuntimeISTCompleteEvent.does: Turns the GPU's runtime in-system-test completion event into a log entry with result and temperatures. Severity comes from the payload.

Temp_0.does: Publishes the main temperature sensor of the device (GPU, SMA or board) in Redfish thermal metrics. Name, sensor id and thresholds differ per kind.

Temp_1.does: Publishes the GPU's thermal-limit headroom sensor (distance to first throttle point) with lower thresholds.

ThresholdEvent.does: Turns the GPU's threshold event into a Critical log entry and Redfish event.

Voltage_0.does: Publishes the GPU's voltage sensor linked to the GPU and its chassis.

WorkloadPowerProfile.does: Publishes the GPU's selectable workload power profiles (with profile ids) for reading and setting.

XIDEvent.does: Turns GPU XID driver error events into Critical log entries and Redfish events with the XID text and resolution link.

Chassis.does: Creates the device's chassis identity: its UUID and MCTP UUID, used by Redfish and by other services to match the device. Needed for every device that has a chassis.

ChassisAttributes.does: Fills in the chassis inventory properties (asset info, location, field-replaceable, chassis type, SKU, health) and optional chassis functions such as power limit, dimensions, write protect and reset metrics. Each optional function is a Supported flag param.

ChassisParentAssociation.does: Links this device's chassis to its parent board or chassis (parent_chassis) so Redfish shows the containment. The ParentChassisAssociationPath param picks board/ or chassis/ as the parent category.

DebugToken.does: Enables debug-token handling for the device: install and status for a unified token, or a token object for NICs. Only built when the debug-token compile option is on.

FWComponentType.does: Placeholder: records the firmware component type but creates nothing; no nsmd consumer exists (code says open question).

HSCC_0_InputVoltage_0.does: Publishes the input voltage of the GPU SMA's HSCC hot-swap controller as a voltage sensor in Redfish.

HSCC_0_OutputVoltage_0.does: Publishes the output voltage of the GPU SMA's HSCC hot-swap controller as a voltage sensor in Redfish.

HSCC_0_Power_0.does: Publishes the power drawn through the GPU SMA's HSCC hot-swap controller as a power sensor in Redfish.

HSCC_0_Temp_0.does: Publishes the temperature of the GPU SMA's HSCC hot-swap controller as a sensor in Redfish.

HSC_0_InputVoltage_0.does: Publishes the input voltage of the GPU SMA's HSC hot-swap controller as a voltage sensor in Redfish.

HSC_0_OutputVoltage_0.does: Publishes the output voltage of the GPU SMA's HSC hot-swap controller as a voltage sensor in Redfish.

HSC_0_Power_0.does: Publishes the power drawn through the GPU SMA's HSC hot-swap controller as a power sensor in Redfish.

HSC_0_Temp_0.does: Publishes the temperature of the GPU SMA's HSC hot-swap controller as a sensor in Redfish.

IRoTAsset.does: Publishes the IRoT's asset data (manufacturer, part and serial number, optional display name) on its chassis.

IRoTAssociations.does: Builds the IRoT's links: parent chassis, the components it protects (RoT inventory) and its chassis. Which links exist is set by the Enabled flags and path params.

IRoTChassisType.does: Sets the IRoT chassis type (for example Component) shown in Redfish. Skipped if no ChassisType param is given.

IRoTFieldReplaceable.does: Marks the IRoT as field replaceable or not in inventory. Skipped if the param is absent.

IRoTHealth.does: Adds a Health status to the IRoT chassis in Redfish.

IRoTLocationCode.does: Sets the IRoT's location code (for example IRoT_0) in inventory. Skipped if no LocationCode param.

IRoTLocationContext.does: Sets the IRoT's location context path (where it sits in the chassis hierarchy) in inventory. Skipped if absent.

IRoTLocationType.does: Sets the IRoT's location type (for example Embedded) in inventory. Skipped if absent.

IRoTSPDMResponder.does: Publishes the IRoT's UUID (and optionally MCTP UUID) so the SPDM service can find and attest it. MctpUuidEnabled adds the MCTP UUID; HGXR disables it.

RoT.does: Creates the Root of Trust firmware model: slots (active and inactive AP and EC), key management, minimum security version, build type, optional image copy, update and failover policies. Slot arrays in params define it.

Temp_0.does: Publishes the main temperature sensor of the device (GPU, SMA or board) in Redfish thermal metrics. Name, sensor id and thresholds differ per kind.

DebugToken.does: Enables debug-token handling for the device: install and status for a unified token, or a token object for NICs. Only built when the debug-token compile option is on.

FWComponentTypeAP.does: Placeholder for the AP firmware component type; logs only and creates nothing visible.

FWComponentTypeEC.does: Placeholder for the EC firmware component type; logs only and creates nothing visible.

IRoTLocationType.does: Sets the IRoT's location type (for example Embedded) in inventory. Skipped if absent.

IRoTSKU.does: Creates the IRoT's SKU property empty; another service (pldm for EC SKU) fills it in. Meaning differs little per kind, only who fills it.

BusBarTemp_0.does: Publishes the processor module's DC bus-bar temperature sensor (read through the SMA) so it appears in Redfish thermal metrics. Thresholds are enabled.

CPU_0_Die_0_Temp_0.does: Publishes the CPU die temperature sensor read through the SMA on a processor module, attached to the module's board chassis in Redfish.

CPU_0_SocTemp_0.does: Publishes the CPU SoC temperature sensor read through the SMA on a processor module, attached to the module's board chassis in Redfish.

EventConfigGPIOState.does: Subscribes the SMA to GPIO state-change events (message type 0, event 3) so GPIO changes are reported.

EventSetting.does: Sets how the device generates events (global event generation setting, for example push) and reads it back. Needed for any event feature to work.

External_SMA_0_Temp_0.does: Publishes the external SMA temperature sensor of a processor module, with thresholds, attached to the module's board chassis.

GPU_VR_Temp_0.does: Publishes the GPU voltage-regulator temperature of a processor module, with thresholds, attached to the module's board chassis.

ProcessorModuleChassis.does: Creates the processor module chassis identity (UUID and PCIe reference clock) on the SMA's module.

ProcessorModuleChassisAttributes.does: Fills in the processor module chassis properties (type Module, SKU, health, write-protect setting).

TotalGpuPower.does: Publishes a synthesized sensor summing all GPU power readings on the zone chassis; GPUs link to it as total_power.

ZoneChassis.does: Creates the logical zone chassis identity on the SMA, named by the ZoneChassisName variable, with UUID and PCIe reference clock.

ZoneChassisAttributes.does: Sets the zone chassis properties (type Zone, no asset info) in inventory.
